28	log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

31	def _is_reminder_day() -> bool:
32	    """Reminders about long-running cases go out once a week, on Mondays."""
33	    return date.today().isoweekday() == calendar.MONDAY
34	
35	
36	@scheduler.add(every(1).day.at("18:00"), name="case-close-reminder")
37	@timer
38	@scheduled_project_task
39	def case_close_reminder(db_session: Session, project: Project):
40	    """Sends a reminder to the case assignee to close out their case."""
41	    cases = get_all_by_status(
42	        db_session=db_session, project_id=project.id, statuses=[CaseStatus.triage]
43	    )
44	
45	    for case in cases:
46	        try:
47	            span = datetime.utcnow() - case.triage_at
48	            q, r = divmod(span.days, 7)
49	            if q >= 1 and _is_reminder_day():
50	                # we only send the reminder for cases that have been triaging
51	                # longer than a week and only on Mondays
52	                send_case_close_reminder(case, db_session)
53	        except Exception as e:
54	            # if one fails we don't want all to fail
55	            log.exception(e)

59	@timer
60	@scheduled_project_task
61	def case_triage_reminder(db_session: Session, project: Project):
62	    """Sends a reminder to the case assignee to triage their case."""
63	
64	    cases = (
65	        db_session.query(Case)
66	        .filter(Case.project_id == project.id)
67	        .filter(Case.status != CaseStatus.closed)
68	        .filter(or_(Case.title == "Security Event Triage", Case.status == CaseStatus.new))
69	        .all()
70	    )
71	
72	    # if we want more specific SLA reminders, we would need to add additional data model
73	    for case in cases:
74	        span = datetime.utcnow() - case.created_at
75	        q, r = divmod(span.days, 1)
76	        if q >= 1:
77	            # we only send one reminder per case per day
78	            send_case_triage_reminder(case, db_session)
